Title: Restricts certain correctional security employees from high-risk assignments following disciplinary action or during a disciplinary evaluation period
Summary: Restricts certain correctional security employees from high-risk assignments following disciplinary action or during a disciplinary evaluation period; provides for restoration of eligibility following completion of a disciplinary evaluation period or other period of assignment restriction; directs the department to notify restricted employees; makes related provisions.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the correction law, in relation to restricting certain correctional security employees from high-risk assignments following disciplinary action or during a disciplinary evaluation period
